"**Love Me like You Do**" is a song recorded by the English singer-songwriter [Ellie Goulding](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellie_Goulding "Ellie Goulding") for the [soundtrack](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fifty_Shades_of_Grey:_Original_Motion_Picture_Soundtrack "Fifty Shades of Grey: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack") to the film *[Fifty Shades of Grey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fifty_Shades_of_Grey_\(film\) "Fifty Shades of Grey (film)")* (2015). The song was written by [Savan Kotecha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Savan_Kotecha "Savan Kotecha"), [Ilya Salmanzadeh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ilya_Salmanzadeh "Ilya Salmanzadeh"), [Tove Lo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tove_Lo "Tove Lo"), [Max Martin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Max_Martin "Max Martin") and [Ali Payami](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ali_Payami "Ali Payami"); the latter two also produced it. Goulding was selected to provide vocals to the track. It was released on 7 January 2015 as the second single from the soundtrack. The song was also included on Goulding's third studio album, *[Delirium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Delirium_\(Ellie_Goulding_album\) "Delirium (Ellie Goulding album)")* (2015).

"Love Me like You Do" is a mid-tempo [electropop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electropop "Electropop") [power ballad](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Power_ballad "Power ballad"), with instrumentation consisting of massive synths and crushing drums. Lyrically, similar to the film's theme, the song talks about the uncontrollable feeling of [falling in love](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falling_in_love "Falling in love") and being [seduced](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seduction "Seduction") by someone whose touch leaves her begging for more, even when it hurts. It received acclaim from [music critics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Music_critics "Music critics"), who praised Goulding's soft vocals and the song for being sultry and grandiose. The song earned Goulding her first [Grammy Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grammy_Award "Grammy Award") nomination for [Best Pop Solo Performance](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Best_Pop_Solo_Performance "Best Pop Solo Performance"), while the songwriters were nominated for the [Grammy Award for Best Song Written for Visual Media](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grammy_Award_for_Best_Song_Written_for_Visual_Media "Grammy Award for Best Song Written for Visual Media"), the [Golden Globe Award for Best Original Song](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Original_Song "Golden Globe Award for Best Original Song"), and the [Broadcast Film Critics Association Award for Best Song](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Broadcast_Film_Critics_Association_Award_for_Best_Song "Broadcast Film Critics Association Award for Best Song").

"Love Me like You Do" topped the [UK Singles Chart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UK_Singles_Chart "UK Singles Chart"), a position it maintained for four weeks and held the record for the most-streamed track in a single week in the United Kingdom at the time. Outside the United Kingdom, "Love Me like You Do" became Goulding's most successful single as well as becoming her first chart-topper in various countries, going number one in over 30 official charts worldwide, including Australia, Austria, Bulgaria, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Italy, Luxembourg, New Zealand, Norway, Poland, Portugal, the Republic of Ireland, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden and Switzerland and peaking within the top ten of the charts in various countries, including Belgium, Colombia and the United States. It was the bestselling song of 2015 in Slovenia. It is certified multiplatinum in fifteen countries including eight-times Platinum in the US, Diamond in Germany and Double Diamond in Poland. Its accompanying music video, which features scenes of the film and Goulding dancing with her partner in a ballroom, received a nomination at the [2015 MTV Video Music Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2015_MTV_Video_Music_Awards "2015 MTV Video Music Awards") for [Best Female Video](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MTV_Video_Music_Award_for_Best_Female_Video "MTV Video Music Award for Best Female Video"), and in 2016 became the 21st video to receive one billion views on [YouTube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube "YouTube"). The video later reached two billion views.

## Background

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Love_Me_like_You_Do&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Background")\]

While seeking material for the [*Fifty Shades of Grey* soundtrack](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fifty_Shades_of_Grey:_Original_Motion_Picture_Soundtrack "Fifty Shades of Grey: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack"), [Republic Records](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Republic_Records "Republic Records") contacted various artists, managers and music publishers to create a compilation that would appropriately represent the film's tone. "Love Me like You Do" was the result of Republic executive Tom Mackay contacting [Max Martin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Max_Martin "Max Martin")'s manager about writing a song for the film.[\[1\]](#cite_note-1) [Ilya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ilya_Salmanzadeh "Ilya Salmanzadeh") started writing the chorus, while [Ali Payami](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ali_Payami "Ali Payami") and Martin came next, with Martin "tweaking" the song and [Savan Kotecha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Savan_Kotecha "Savan Kotecha") and [Tove Lo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tove_Lo "Tove Lo") also contributing with lyrics. According to Kotecha, "Love Me like You Do" was already being developed by both him and Martin prior to *[Fifty Shades of Grey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fifty_Shades_of_Grey_\(film\) "Fifty Shades of Grey (film)")*, and he had considered giving the song to American singer [Demi Lovato](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demi_Lovato "Demi Lovato"). However, after being shown a scene from the film during a meeting for the film's soundtrack, Martin thought "Love Me like You Do" could work, and began reworking the song for inclusion.[\[2\]](#cite_note-2) After that, the film director [Sam Taylor-Johnson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sam_Taylor-Johnson "Sam Taylor-Johnson") asked [Ellie Goulding](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellie_Goulding "Ellie Goulding") to sing the song. Goulding, who previously contributed songs to the soundtracks to *[The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Twilight_Saga:_Breaking_Dawn_–_Part_2_\(soundtrack\) "The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 2 (soundtrack)")*, *[The Hunger Games: Catching Fire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Hunger_Games:_Catching_Fire_–_Original_Motion_Picture_Soundtrack "The Hunger Games: Catching Fire – Original Motion Picture Soundtrack")* and *[Divergent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Divergent:_Original_Motion_Picture_Soundtrack "Divergent: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack")*, initially thought about declining the invitation to record another song for a soundtrack to focus on her then-upcoming third studio album. However, after meeting the film crew and hearing the ballad she accepted.[\[3\]](#cite_note-ryan-3) She commented:

> "I wasn't going to get involved in that soundtrack because I've done a lot of soundtracks and we kind of thought we've done a bit too much film stuff. So we should probably just chill and write that third album, which is what I should be focusing on. And then I met the director \[Sam Taylor-Johnson\] and everyone involved and I was like, 'This is a pretty cool thing to be involved in.' Then I heard the song and I was like, 'Woah, this is a pretty awesome song.' I didn't know that it was going to be this big, genuinely. I thought \[maybe\] it would do well."[\[3\]](#cite_note-ryan-3)

A slightly reworked version of the song was included on the soundtrack to the 2018 film *[Fifty Shades Freed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fifty_Shades_Freed_\(film\) "Fifty Shades Freed (film)")*, the third and final installment in the series.[\[4\]](#cite_note-4)

## Composition and lyrics

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Love_Me_like_You_Do&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Composition and lyrics")\]

"Love Me like You Do" was written by [Max Martin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Max_Martin "Max Martin"), [Savan Kotecha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Savan_Kotecha "Savan Kotecha"), [Ilya Salmanzadeh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ilya_Salmanzadeh "Ilya Salmanzadeh"), [Ali Payami](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ali_Payami "Ali Payami") and [Tove Lo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tove_Lo "Tove Lo"), with production by Martin and Payami; they were also responsible for [programming](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Programming_\(music\) "Programming (music)"), drums, percussion, keys and bass. Strings were arranged by Mattias Bylund, violin was played by Mattias Johansson and cello by David Bukovinsky. Peter Carlsson was responsible for vocal editing, as well as background vocals, along with Martin, Payami, Ilya, Kotecha, [Oscar Holter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oscar_Holter "Oscar Holter"), Robin Fredriksson, Mattias Larsson, [Oscar Görres](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oscar_Görres "Oscar Görres") and Ludvig Söderberg. It was recorded in Los Angeles and Stockholm.[\[5\]](#cite_note-notes-5) According to the sheet music published at MusicNotes.com by [Kobalt Music Group](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kobalt_Music_Group "Kobalt Music Group"), the song is written in the key of [A♭ major](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A-flat_major "A-flat major"), with a moderate [tempo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tempo "Tempo") of 95 [beats per minute](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beats_per_minute "Beats per minute"). Goulding's vocal range spans from the low note of A♭3 to the high note of E♭5.[\[6\]](#cite_note-6)

"Love Me like You Do" is a tender [electropop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electropop "Electropop") [power ballad](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Power_ballad "Power ballad"),[\[7\]](#cite_note-7)[\[8\]](#cite_note-Reed-8)[\[9\]](#cite_note-idolator-9) with a "synth-filled, '80s-sounding" production.[\[10\]](#cite_note-pluggedin-10) Its instrumentation consists of massive synthesisers and crushing drums,[\[8\]](#cite_note-Reed-8) while Goulding delivers a "soft, understated vocals".[\[9\]](#cite_note-idolator-9) In the opening seconds she sings, "You're the cure/ you're the pain/ you're the only thing I want to touch/ Never knew that it/ could mean so much/ You're the fear/ I don't care/ 'Cause I've never been so high."[\[11\]](#cite_note-11) Lyrically, "Love Me like You Do" contrasts "innocent romantic longing" and "brooding, addictive, pain-laced sensuality", which according to [Plugged In (publication)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plugged_In_\(publication\) "Plugged In (publication)")'s Adam R. Holz, "mirrors the [story arc](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Story_arc "Story arc") of [Anastasia Steele](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anastasia_Steele "Anastasia Steele") and [Christian Grey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christian_Grey "Christian Grey")" in both the book and the film. He went on to explain its lyrical content: "\[It\] tells the tale of a woman entranced and seduced by someone whose touch leaves her begging for more, even when—or perhaps especially when—it hurts."[\[10\]](#cite_note-pluggedin-10)

## Critical reception

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Love_Me_like_You_Do&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Critical reception")\]

"Love Me like You Do" was acclaimed by music critics. Samantha Grossman of *[Time](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Time_\(magazine\) "Time (magazine)")* called the song "sultry" and dubbed it a "solid addition to the *Fifty Shades* soundtrack."[\[12\]](#cite_note-12) Christina Garibaldi of [MTV News](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MTV_News "MTV News") also called it "sultry" and "soft", adding that "we can totally picture it being played during any steamy scene."[\[13\]](#cite_note-13) Ryan Reed of *[Rolling Stone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rolling_Stone "Rolling Stone")* opined that its "results are grandiose, considering the film's sensual subject matter."[\[8\]](#cite_note-Reed-8) Jim Farber of the [New York *Daily News*](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York_Daily_News "New York Daily News") praised her "little-girl-lost voice", noting that "Goulding sounds sweet even when she's courting danger. The music, likewise, goes for a high gloss take on romance, recalling the heavily echoed beats and dense synthesizers of a [Phil Collins](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phil_Collins "Phil Collins") ballad from the '80s."[\[14\]](#cite_note-14) Robbie Daw of [Idolator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Idolator_\(website\) "Idolator (website)") described "Love Me like You Do" as "a sweeping power ballad that finds Goulding delivering soft, understated vocals over producer Max Martin's swelling bed of synths."[\[9\]](#cite_note-idolator-9) Lucas Villa of [AXS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AXS_\(ticket_merchant\) "AXS (ticket merchant)") commended Goulding for "masterfully tread\[ing\] between delicacy and power in her performance", calling the song "intimately magnificent".[\[15\]](#cite_note-15) Glenn Gamboa of *[Newsday](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Newsday "Newsday")* called it "sweet, catchy, near-perfect [rom-com](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romantic_comedy "Romantic comedy") fare".[\[16\]](#cite_note-Gamboa-16)

Carolyn Menyes of *Music Times* complimented the song for being "sweet and dreamy, like the majority of Goulding's discography", also observing that "\[t\]he crawling pace works well as Goulding rolls her way through the melody, all at once being enchanting and loving. Her breathy vocals, as always, complete the atmospheric sensibility of the track."[\[17\]](#cite_note-musictimes-17) While reviewing the *[Fifty Shades of Grey soundtrack](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fifty_Shades_of_Grey:_Original_Motion_Picture_Soundtrack "Fifty Shades of Grey: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack")*, Dave Holmes wrote for *[Esquire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esquire_\(magazine\) "Esquire (magazine)")* that the song was "\[t\]he closest thing to a single we've heard so far", adding that the song has "a touch of longing, a little bit of a beat" and "Goulding's voice is the sound of heavy petting."[\[18\]](#cite_note-Holmes-18) Mikael Wood, writing for *[Los Angeles Times](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles_Times "Los Angeles Times")*, said that Goulding "put across a tender sensuality \[...\] even as super-producer Max Martin jacks the stadium-rave beat."[\[19\]](#cite_note-Wood-19) [Stephen Thomas Erlewine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stephen_Thomas_Erlewine "Stephen Thomas Erlewine") of [AllMusic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AllMusic "AllMusic"), in his soundtrack analysis, wrote that "it moves into the area of background romantic music, a vibe that's sometimes pierced by those overly familiar oldies that surely play a bigger role onscreen than they do on album."[\[20\]](#cite_note-20) In a less favourable review, Jason Lipshutz of *[Billboard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_\(magazine\) "Billboard (magazine)")* gave the song two and a half stars out of five, complimenting Goulding's voice as "one of pop's more distinct voices" and the tune's "colossal chorus", but panning its "clichéd lyrics".[\[21\]](#cite_note-21)

## Commercial performance

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Love_Me_like_You_Do&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: Commercial performance")\]

"Love Me like You Do" entered at the top of the [UK Singles Chart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UK_Singles_Chart "UK Singles Chart") with first-week sales of 172,368 units, becoming Goulding's second number one on the chart after "[Burn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burn_\(Ellie_Goulding_song\) "Burn (Ellie Goulding song)")" (2013).[\[28\]](#cite_note-28)[\[29\]](#cite_note-29) The single remained at number one for a second week with chart sales of 118,225 copies and 2\.25 million streams,[\[30\]](#cite_note-30)[\[31\]](#cite_note-31) and then a third consecutive week selling a further 118,000 copies. In its third week at number one, "Love Me like You Do" broke the streaming record in the United Kingdom at the time, with 2\.58 million streams over seven days, surpassing [Mark Ronson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mark_Ronson "Mark Ronson")'s "[Uptown Funk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uptown_Funk "Uptown Funk")" previous record.[\[32\]](#cite_note-32) At the same time, the song was streamed almost 15\.5 million times globally.[\[33\]](#cite_note-33) It spent a total of four weeks at the top of the UK Singles Chart, becoming her longest number-one single on the listing.[\[34\]](#cite_note-34)

Elsewhere in Europe, "Love Me like You Do" topped the charts in Austria,[\[35\]](#cite_note-aus-35) Bulgaria,[\[36\]](#cite_note-bulgaria-36) the Czech Republic,[\[37\]](#cite_note-cz-37) Denmark,[\[38\]](#cite_note-den-38) Finland,[\[39\]](#cite_note-fin-39) Germany,[\[40\]](#cite_note-ger-40) Greece,[\[41\]](#cite_note-greece-41) Hungary,[\[42\]](#cite_note-hun-42) Ireland,[\[43\]](#cite_note-ire-43) Italy,[\[44\]](#cite_note-italy-44) Luxembourg,[\[45\]](#cite_note-lux-45) Norway,[\[46\]](#cite_note-nor-46) Poland,[\[47\]](#cite_note-pol-47) Portugal,[\[48\]](#cite_note-por-48) Slovakia,[\[49\]](#cite_note-slk-49) Slovenia,[\[50\]](#cite_note-slv-50) Spain,[\[51\]](#cite_note-spa-51) Sweden[\[52\]](#cite_note-swe-52) and Switzerland.[\[53\]](#cite_note-swi-53) In France, the song peaked at number five, Goulding's highest-charting single and second top-10 single on the [French Singles Chart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_Singles_Chart "French Singles Chart").[\[54\]](#cite_note-france-54) In the Netherlands, the song became her first solo single to reach the top 10, peaking at number two on the [Dutch Top 40](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dutch_Top_40 "Dutch Top 40").[\[55\]](#cite_note-dutch-55)

In the United States, "Love Me like You Do" debuted at number 45 on the [*Billboard* Hot 100](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_Hot_100 "Billboard Hot 100") chart dated 24 January 2015, with first-week sales of 79,000 copies.[\[56\]](#cite_note-56) The following week, the song climbed to number 36,[\[57\]](#cite_note-57) and then to number 20 in its third week.[\[58\]](#cite_note-58) On the issue dated 14 February 2015, it rose to number 14\.[\[59\]](#cite_note-59) "Love Me like You Do" reached number nine the following week, becoming Goulding's second top-10 entry on the chart.[\[60\]](#cite_note-60) In its seventh week, the song peaked at number three on the *Billboard* Hot 100, becoming her highest-charting single since "[Lights](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lights_\(Ellie_Goulding_song\) "Lights (Ellie Goulding song)")" peaked at number two on the chart in July 2012\.[\[61\]](#cite_note-61) On the [Pop Songs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pop_Songs "Pop Songs") chart, it was her second single to top the charts,[\[62\]](#cite_note-62) and on the [Adult Top 40](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adult_Top_40 "Adult Top 40") chart, it was her first number-one.[\[63\]](#cite_note-63) "Love Me like You Do" debuted at number 38 on the [Canadian Hot 100](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canadian_Hot_100 "Canadian Hot 100") for the week ending 24 January 2015,[\[64\]](#cite_note-64) later peaking at number three.[\[65\]](#cite_note-65)[\[66\]](#cite_note-can-66)

In Australasia, track entered at number eight on the [Australian Singles Chart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ARIA_Charts "ARIA Charts") and at number three on the [New Zealand Singles Chart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Zealand_Singles_Chart "New Zealand Singles Chart"). In its fourth week, "Love Me like You Do" reached number one on both charts, becoming Goulding's first number-one single in both countries.[\[35\]](#cite_note-aus-35)[\[67\]](#cite_note-nz-67)

## Music video

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Love_Me_like_You_Do&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: Music video")\]

The music video for "Love Me like You Do" was directed by Georgia Hudson and premiered on 22 January 2015\.[\[68\]](#cite_note-68) It stars Goulding and her on-screen partner, Charlie Harding, [ballroom dancing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ballroom_dance "Ballroom dance") in a mansion, as well as scenes from *Fifty Shades of Grey*. Regarding the dance in the video, she commented: "I am in it. That's me! I'm dancing in it!. \[...\] I basically have become fascinated with ballroom dancing so I was like, 'Can I please do some dancing in it?'. So they let me do that. There's a guy in it, Charlie, and there's some really sensual moments in it, and it's in a really beautiful house. I think it's one of my favorite videos."[\[69\]](#cite_note-69) The video received a nomination for [Best Female Video](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MTV_Video_Music_Award_for_Best_Female_Video "MTV Video Music Award for Best Female Video") at the [2015 MTV Video Music Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2015_MTV_Video_Music_Awards "2015 MTV Video Music Awards").[\[70\]](#cite_note-70) The video passed one billion views on [YouTube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube "YouTube") at the end of February 2016; the 21st song to achieve this milestone.[\[71\]](#cite_note-71)

In France, the music video was broadcast on some channels with a warning *Not advised to kids under 10 years old* (in French : déconseillé aux moins de 10 ans) with some scenes from the movie blurred.[\[72\]](#cite_note-72)

## Live performances and cover versions

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Love_Me_like_You_Do&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: Live performances and cover versions")\]

### Live

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Love_Me_like_You_Do&action=edit&section=8 "Edit section: Live")\]

Goulding performed "Love Me like You Do" in March 2015 at a [Nike](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nike,_Inc. "Nike, Inc.") app launch. On 17 October 2015, Goulding was invited by [Taylor Swift](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taylor_Swift "Taylor Swift") on her [1989 Tour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_1989_World_Tour "The 1989 World Tour") as a surprise guest to sing a duet with her.[\[73\]](#cite_note-73) On 25 October 2015, Goulding delivered a performance at the [2015 MTV Europe Music Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2015_MTV_Europe_Music_Awards "2015 MTV Europe Music Awards"), which *[Billboard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_\(magazine\) "Billboard (magazine)")* called "sexy" and "straightforward".[\[74\]](#cite_note-74) On 7 November 2015, she sang it at the [NRJ Music Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NRJ_Music_Awards "NRJ Music Awards").[\[75\]](#cite_note-75) In the same month, she was also part of the [American Express Unstaged](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Express_Unstaged "American Express Unstaged"), directed by [Scarlett Johansson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scarlett_Johansson "Scarlett Johansson").[\[76\]](#cite_note-76) On 20 November 2015, Goulding's performance at *[Idol Sweden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Idol_\(Swedish_TV_series\) "Idol (Swedish TV series)")* included the song.[\[77\]](#cite_note-77) On 24 November 2015, she and [James Corden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Corden "James Corden") sang it in several genres during *[The Late Late Show with James Corden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Late_Late_Show_with_James_Corden "The Late Late Show with James Corden")*, including rock, hip hop, country, rave, reggae, folk, and gospel.[\[78\]](#cite_note-78) Goulding performed it during [Victoria's Secret Fashion Show](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Victoria's_Secret_Fashion_Show_2015 "Victoria's Secret Fashion Show 2015"), which aired on 8 December 2015\. On 6 December 2015, she appeared at [Capital FM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital_\(radio_network\) "Capital (radio network)")'s [Jingle Bell Ball](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jingle_Bell_Ball "Jingle Bell Ball").[\[79\]](#cite_note-79) On 10 December 2015, she gave another rendition of the song at the [2015 BBC Music Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2015_BBC_Music_Awards "2015 BBC Music Awards") with the BBC Concert Orchestra.[\[80\]](#cite_note-80) On 18 April 2020, Goulding performed the song's acoustic version at *[One World: Together at Home](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/One_World:_Together_at_Home "One World: Together at Home")*.[\[81\]](#cite_note-81)

On 13 October 2023, Goulding performed an orchestral arrangement of the song composed by Japanese rock star [Yoshiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yoshiki_\(musician\) "Yoshiki (musician)") at [Royal Albert Hall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_Albert_Hall "Royal Albert Hall").[\[82\]](#cite_note-82)

### Covers

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Love_Me_like_You_Do&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section: Covers")\]

In March 2015, [Circa Waves](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circa_Waves "Circa Waves") performed a rock cover at [BBC Radio 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BBC_Radio_1 "BBC Radio 1")'s [Live Lounge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Live_Lounge "Live Lounge").[\[83\]](#cite_note-83) That same month, [James Arthur](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Arthur "James Arthur") covered the song for [MTV](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MTV "MTV").[\[84\]](#cite_note-84) In May 2015, [Ella Henderson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ella_Henderson "Ella Henderson") delivered an acoustic cover at Spin 1038 Live Room.[\[85\]](#cite_note-85) In September 2015, [Rhodes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhodes_\(singer\) "Rhodes (singer)") covered the song at BBC Radio 1's Live Lounge.[\[86\]](#cite_note-86)

The song appears in the 2019 [Max Martin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Max_Martin "Max Martin") jukebox musical *[& Juliet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/&_Juliet "& Juliet")* where it is performed by [Romeo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romeo "Romeo").[\[87\]](#cite_note-87) [Jordan Luke Gage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jordan_Luke_Gage "Jordan Luke Gage"), who originated the role on the [West End](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_End_theatre "West End theatre"), recorded the song for the official cast soundtrack.[\[88\]](#cite_note-88)

"**Love Me like You Do**" is a song recorded by the English singer-songwriter [Ellie Goulding](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellie_Goulding "Ellie Goulding") for the [soundtrack](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fifty_Shades_of_Grey:_Original_Motion_Picture_Soundtrack "Fifty Shades of Grey: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack") to the film *[Fifty Shades of Grey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fifty_Shades_of_Grey_\(film\) "Fifty Shades of Grey (film)")* (2015). The song was written by [Savan Kotecha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Savan_Kotecha "Savan Kotecha"), [Ilya Salmanzadeh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ilya_Salmanzadeh "Ilya Salmanzadeh"), [Tove Lo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tove_Lo "Tove Lo"), [Max Martin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Max_Martin "Max Martin") and [Ali Payami](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ali_Payami "Ali Payami"); the latter two also produced it. Goulding was selected to provide vocals to the track. It was released on 7 January 2015 as the second single from the soundtrack. The song was also included on Goulding's third studio album, *[Delirium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Delirium_\(Ellie_Goulding_album\) "Delirium (Ellie Goulding album)")* (2015).

"Love Me like You Do" is a mid-tempo [electropop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electropop "Electropop") [power ballad](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Power_ballad "Power ballad"), with instrumentation consisting of massive synths and crushing drums. Lyrically, similar to the film's theme, the song talks about the uncontrollable feeling of [falling in love](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falling_in_love "Falling in love") and being [seduced](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seduction "Seduction") by someone whose touch leaves her begging for more, even when it hurts. It received acclaim from [music critics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Music_critics "Music critics"), who praised Goulding's soft vocals and the song for being sultry and grandiose. The song earned Goulding her first [Grammy Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grammy_Award "Grammy Award") nomination for [Best Pop Solo Performance](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Best_Pop_Solo_Performance "Best Pop Solo Performance"), while the songwriters were nominated for the [Grammy Award for Best Song Written for Visual Media](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grammy_Award_for_Best_Song_Written_for_Visual_Media "Grammy Award for Best Song Written for Visual Media"), the [Golden Globe Award for Best Original Song](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Original_Song "Golden Globe Award for Best Original Song"), and the [Broadcast Film Critics Association Award for Best Song](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Broadcast_Film_Critics_Association_Award_for_Best_Song "Broadcast Film Critics Association Award for Best Song").

"Love Me like You Do" topped the [UK Singles Chart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UK_Singles_Chart "UK Singles Chart"), a position it maintained for four weeks and held the record for the most-streamed track in a single week in the United Kingdom at the time. Outside the United Kingdom, "Love Me like You Do" became Goulding's most successful single as well as becoming her first chart-topper in various countries, going number one in over 30 official charts worldwide, including Australia, Austria, Bulgaria, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Italy, Luxembourg, New Zealand, Norway, Poland, Portugal, the Republic of Ireland, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden and Switzerland and peaking within the top ten of the charts in various countries, including Belgium, Colombia and the United States. It was the bestselling song of 2015 in Slovenia. It is certified multiplatinum in fifteen countries including eight-times Platinum in the US, Diamond in Germany and Double Diamond in Poland. Its accompanying music video, which features scenes of the film and Goulding dancing with her partner in a ballroom, received a nomination at the [2015 MTV Video Music Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2015_MTV_Video_Music_Awards "2015 MTV Video Music Awards") for [Best Female Video](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MTV_Video_Music_Award_for_Best_Female_Video "MTV Video Music Award for Best Female Video"), and in 2016 became the 21st video to receive one billion views on [YouTube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube "YouTube"). The video later reached two billion views.

## Background

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Love_Me_like_You_Do&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Background")\]

While seeking material for the [*Fifty Shades of Grey* soundtrack](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fifty_Shades_of_Grey:_Original_Motion_Picture_Soundtrack "Fifty Shades of Grey: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack"), [Republic Records](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Republic_Records "Republic Records") contacted various artists, managers and music publishers to create a compilation that would appropriately represent the film's tone. "Love Me like You Do" was the result of Republic executive Tom Mackay contacting [Max Martin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Max_Martin "Max Martin")'s manager about writing a song for the film.[\[1\]](#cite_note-1) [Ilya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ilya_Salmanzadeh "Ilya Salmanzadeh") started writing the chorus, while [Ali Payami](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ali_Payami "Ali Payami") and Martin came next, with Martin "tweaking" the song and [Savan Kotecha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Savan_Kotecha "Savan Kotecha") and [Tove Lo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tove_Lo "Tove Lo") also contributing with lyrics. According to Kotecha, "Love Me like You Do" was already being developed by both him and Martin prior to *[Fifty Shades of Grey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fifty_Shades_of_Grey_\(film\) "Fifty Shades of Grey (film)")*, and he had considered giving the song to American singer [Demi Lovato](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demi_Lovato "Demi Lovato"). However, after being shown a scene from the film during a meeting for the film's soundtrack, Martin thought "Love Me like You Do" could work, and began reworking the song for inclusion.[\[2\]](#cite_note-2) After that, the film director [Sam Taylor-Johnson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sam_Taylor-Johnson "Sam Taylor-Johnson") asked [Ellie Goulding](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellie_Goulding "Ellie Goulding") to sing the song. Goulding, who previously contributed songs to the soundtracks to *[The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Twilight_Saga:_Breaking_Dawn_–_Part_2_\(soundtrack\) "The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 2 (soundtrack)")*, *[The Hunger Games: Catching Fire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Hunger_Games:_Catching_Fire_–_Original_Motion_Picture_Soundtrack "The Hunger Games: Catching Fire – Original Motion Picture Soundtrack")* and *[Divergent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Divergent:_Original_Motion_Picture_Soundtrack "Divergent: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack")*, initially thought about declining the invitation to record another song for a soundtrack to focus on her then-upcoming third studio album. However, after meeting the film crew and hearing the ballad she accepted.[\[3\]](#cite_note-ryan-3) She commented:

> "I wasn't going to get involved in that soundtrack because I've done a lot of soundtracks and we kind of thought we've done a bit too much film stuff. So we should probably just chill and write that third album, which is what I should be focusing on. And then I met the director \[Sam Taylor-Johnson\] and everyone involved and I was like, 'This is a pretty cool thing to be involved in.' Then I heard the song and I was like, 'Woah, this is a pretty awesome song.' I didn't know that it was going to be this big, genuinely. I thought \[maybe\] it would do well."[\[3\]](#cite_note-ryan-3)

A slightly reworked version of the song was included on the soundtrack to the 2018 film *[Fifty Shades Freed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fifty_Shades_Freed_\(film\) "Fifty Shades Freed (film)")*, the third and final installment in the series.[\[4\]](#cite_note-4)

## Composition and lyrics

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Love_Me_like_You_Do&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Composition and lyrics")\]

"Love Me like You Do" was written by [Max Martin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Max_Martin "Max Martin"), [Savan Kotecha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Savan_Kotecha "Savan Kotecha"), [Ilya Salmanzadeh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ilya_Salmanzadeh "Ilya Salmanzadeh"), [Ali Payami](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ali_Payami "Ali Payami") and [Tove Lo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tove_Lo "Tove Lo"), with production by Martin and Payami; they were also responsible for [programming](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Programming_\(music\) "Programming (music)"), drums, percussion, keys and bass. Strings were arranged by Mattias Bylund, violin was played by Mattias Johansson and cello by David Bukovinsky. Peter Carlsson was responsible for vocal editing, as well as background vocals, along with Martin, Payami, Ilya, Kotecha, [Oscar Holter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oscar_Holter "Oscar Holter"), Robin Fredriksson, Mattias Larsson, [Oscar Görres](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oscar_Görres "Oscar Görres") and Ludvig Söderberg. It was recorded in Los Angeles and Stockholm.[\[5\]](#cite_note-notes-5) According to the sheet music published at MusicNotes.com by [Kobalt Music Group](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kobalt_Music_Group "Kobalt Music Group"), the song is written in the key of [A♭ major](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A-flat_major "A-flat major"), with a moderate [tempo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tempo "Tempo") of 95 [beats per minute](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beats_per_minute "Beats per minute"). Goulding's vocal range spans from the low note of A♭3 to the high note of E♭5.[\[6\]](#cite_note-6)

"Love Me like You Do" is a tender [electropop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electropop "Electropop") [power ballad](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Power_ballad "Power ballad"),[\[7\]](#cite_note-7)[\[8\]](#cite_note-Reed-8)[\[9\]](#cite_note-idolator-9) with a "synth-filled, '80s-sounding" production.[\[10\]](#cite_note-pluggedin-10) Its instrumentation consists of massive synthesisers and crushing drums,[\[8\]](#cite_note-Reed-8) while Goulding delivers a "soft, understated vocals".[\[9\]](#cite_note-idolator-9) In the opening seconds she sings, "You're the cure/ you're the pain/ you're the only thing I want to touch/ Never knew that it/ could mean so much/ You're the fear/ I don't care/ 'Cause I've never been so high."[\[11\]](#cite_note-11) Lyrically, "Love Me like You Do" contrasts "innocent romantic longing" and "brooding, addictive, pain-laced sensuality", which according to [Plugged In (publication)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plugged_In_\(publication\) "Plugged In (publication)")'s Adam R. Holz, "mirrors the [story arc](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Story_arc "Story arc") of [Anastasia Steele](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anastasia_Steele "Anastasia Steele") and [Christian Grey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christian_Grey "Christian Grey")" in both the book and the film. He went on to explain its lyrical content: "\[It\] tells the tale of a woman entranced and seduced by someone whose touch leaves her begging for more, even when—or perhaps especially when—it hurts."[\[10\]](#cite_note-pluggedin-10)

## Critical reception

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Love_Me_like_You_Do&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Critical reception")\]

"Love Me like You Do" was acclaimed by music critics. Samantha Grossman of *[Time](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Time_\(magazine\) "Time (magazine)")* called the song "sultry" and dubbed it a "solid addition to the *Fifty Shades* soundtrack."[\[12\]](#cite_note-12) Christina Garibaldi of [MTV News](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MTV_News "MTV News") also called it "sultry" and "soft", adding that "we can totally picture it being played during any steamy scene."[\[13\]](#cite_note-13) Ryan Reed of *[Rolling Stone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rolling_Stone "Rolling Stone")* opined that its "results are grandiose, considering the film's sensual subject matter."[\[8\]](#cite_note-Reed-8) Jim Farber of the [New York *Daily News*](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York_Daily_News "New York Daily News") praised her "little-girl-lost voice", noting that "Goulding sounds sweet even when she's courting danger. The music, likewise, goes for a high gloss take on romance, recalling the heavily echoed beats and dense synthesizers of a [Phil Collins](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phil_Collins "Phil Collins") ballad from the '80s."[\[14\]](#cite_note-14) Robbie Daw of [Idolator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Idolator_\(website\) "Idolator (website)") described "Love Me like You Do" as "a sweeping power ballad that finds Goulding delivering soft, understated vocals over producer Max Martin's swelling bed of synths."[\[9\]](#cite_note-idolator-9) Lucas Villa of [AXS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AXS_\(ticket_merchant\) "AXS (ticket merchant)") commended Goulding for "masterfully tread\[ing\] between delicacy and power in her performance", calling the song "intimately magnificent".[\[15\]](#cite_note-15) Glenn Gamboa of *[Newsday](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Newsday "Newsday")* called it "sweet, catchy, near-perfect [rom-com](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romantic_comedy "Romantic comedy") fare".[\[16\]](#cite_note-Gamboa-16)

Carolyn Menyes of *Music Times* complimented the song for being "sweet and dreamy, like the majority of Goulding's discography", also observing that "\[t\]he crawling pace works well as Goulding rolls her way through the melody, all at once being enchanting and loving. Her breathy vocals, as always, complete the atmospheric sensibility of the track."[\[17\]](#cite_note-musictimes-17) While reviewing the *[Fifty Shades of Grey soundtrack](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fifty_Shades_of_Grey:_Original_Motion_Picture_Soundtrack "Fifty Shades of Grey: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack")*, Dave Holmes wrote for *[Esquire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esquire_\(magazine\) "Esquire (magazine)")* that the song was "\[t\]he closest thing to a single we've heard so far", adding that the song has "a touch of longing, a little bit of a beat" and "Goulding's voice is the sound of heavy petting."[\[18\]](#cite_note-Holmes-18) Mikael Wood, writing for *[Los Angeles Times](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles_Times "Los Angeles Times")*, said that Goulding "put across a tender sensuality \[...\] even as super-producer Max Martin jacks the stadium-rave beat."[\[19\]](#cite_note-Wood-19) [Stephen Thomas Erlewine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stephen_Thomas_Erlewine "Stephen Thomas Erlewine") of [AllMusic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AllMusic "AllMusic"), in his soundtrack analysis, wrote that "it moves into the area of background romantic music, a vibe that's sometimes pierced by those overly familiar oldies that surely play a bigger role onscreen than they do on album."[\[20\]](#cite_note-20) In a less favourable review, Jason Lipshutz of *[Billboard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_\(magazine\) "Billboard (magazine)")* gave the song two and a half stars out of five, complimenting Goulding's voice as "one of pop's more distinct voices" and the tune's "colossal chorus", but panning its "clichéd lyrics".[\[21\]](#cite_note-21)

## Commercial performance

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Love_Me_like_You_Do&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: Commercial performance")\]

"Love Me like You Do" entered at the top of the [UK Singles Chart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UK_Singles_Chart "UK Singles Chart") with first-week sales of 172,368 units, becoming Goulding's second number one on the chart after "[Burn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burn_\(Ellie_Goulding_song\) "Burn (Ellie Goulding song)")" (2013).[\[28\]](#cite_note-28)[\[29\]](#cite_note-29) The single remained at number one for a second week with chart sales of 118,225 copies and 2\.25 million streams,[\[30\]](#cite_note-30)[\[31\]](#cite_note-31) and then a third consecutive week selling a further 118,000 copies. In its third week at number one, "Love Me like You Do" broke the streaming record in the United Kingdom at the time, with 2\.58 million streams over seven days, surpassing [Mark Ronson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mark_Ronson "Mark Ronson")'s "[Uptown Funk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uptown_Funk "Uptown Funk")" previous record.[\[32\]](#cite_note-32) At the same time, the song was streamed almost 15\.5 million times globally.[\[33\]](#cite_note-33) It spent a total of four weeks at the top of the UK Singles Chart, becoming her longest number-one single on the listing.[\[34\]](#cite_note-34)

Elsewhere in Europe, "Love Me like You Do" topped the charts in Austria,[\[35\]](#cite_note-aus-35) Bulgaria,[\[36\]](#cite_note-bulgaria-36) the Czech Republic,[\[37\]](#cite_note-cz-37) Denmark,[\[38\]](#cite_note-den-38) Finland,[\[39\]](#cite_note-fin-39) Germany,[\[40\]](#cite_note-ger-40) Greece,[\[41\]](#cite_note-greece-41) Hungary,[\[42\]](#cite_note-hun-42) Ireland,[\[43\]](#cite_note-ire-43) Italy,[\[44\]](#cite_note-italy-44) Luxembourg,[\[45\]](#cite_note-lux-45) Norway,[\[46\]](#cite_note-nor-46) Poland,[\[47\]](#cite_note-pol-47) Portugal,[\[48\]](#cite_note-por-48) Slovakia,[\[49\]](#cite_note-slk-49) Slovenia,[\[50\]](#cite_note-slv-50) Spain,[\[51\]](#cite_note-spa-51) Sweden[\[52\]](#cite_note-swe-52) and Switzerland.[\[53\]](#cite_note-swi-53) In France, the song peaked at number five, Goulding's highest-charting single and second top-10 single on the [French Singles Chart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_Singles_Chart "French Singles Chart").[\[54\]](#cite_note-france-54) In the Netherlands, the song became her first solo single to reach the top 10, peaking at number two on the [Dutch Top 40](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dutch_Top_40 "Dutch Top 40").[\[55\]](#cite_note-dutch-55)

In the United States, "Love Me like You Do" debuted at number 45 on the [*Billboard* Hot 100](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_Hot_100 "Billboard Hot 100") chart dated 24 January 2015, with first-week sales of 79,000 copies.[\[56\]](#cite_note-56) The following week, the song climbed to number 36,[\[57\]](#cite_note-57) and then to number 20 in its third week.[\[58\]](#cite_note-58) On the issue dated 14 February 2015, it rose to number 14\.[\[59\]](#cite_note-59) "Love Me like You Do" reached number nine the following week, becoming Goulding's second top-10 entry on the chart.[\[60\]](#cite_note-60) In its seventh week, the song peaked at number three on the *Billboard* Hot 100, becoming her highest-charting single since "[Lights](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lights_\(Ellie_Goulding_song\) "Lights (Ellie Goulding song)")" peaked at number two on the chart in July 2012\.[\[61\]](#cite_note-61) On the [Pop Songs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pop_Songs "Pop Songs") chart, it was her second single to top the charts,[\[62\]](#cite_note-62) and on the [Adult Top 40](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adult_Top_40 "Adult Top 40") chart, it was her first number-one.[\[63\]](#cite_note-63) "Love Me like You Do" debuted at number 38 on the [Canadian Hot 100](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canadian_Hot_100 "Canadian Hot 100") for the week ending 24 January 2015,[\[64\]](#cite_note-64) later peaking at number three.[\[65\]](#cite_note-65)[\[66\]](#cite_note-can-66)

In Australasia, track entered at number eight on the [Australian Singles Chart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ARIA_Charts "ARIA Charts") and at number three on the [New Zealand Singles Chart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Zealand_Singles_Chart "New Zealand Singles Chart"). In its fourth week, "Love Me like You Do" reached number one on both charts, becoming Goulding's first number-one single in both countries.[\[35\]](#cite_note-aus-35)[\[67\]](#cite_note-nz-67)

## Music video

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Love_Me_like_You_Do&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: Music video")\]

The music video for "Love Me like You Do" was directed by Georgia Hudson and premiered on 22 January 2015\.[\[68\]](#cite_note-68) It stars Goulding and her on-screen partner, Charlie Harding, [ballroom dancing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ballroom_dance "Ballroom dance") in a mansion, as well as scenes from *Fifty Shades of Grey*. Regarding the dance in the video, she commented: "I am in it. That's me! I'm dancing in it!. \[...\] I basically have become fascinated with ballroom dancing so I was like, 'Can I please do some dancing in it?'. So they let me do that. There's a guy in it, Charlie, and there's some really sensual moments in it, and it's in a really beautiful house. I think it's one of my favorite videos."[\[69\]](#cite_note-69) The video received a nomination for [Best Female Video](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MTV_Video_Music_Award_for_Best_Female_Video "MTV Video Music Award for Best Female Video") at the [2015 MTV Video Music Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2015_MTV_Video_Music_Awards "2015 MTV Video Music Awards").[\[70\]](#cite_note-70) The video passed one billion views on [YouTube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube "YouTube") at the end of February 2016; the 21st song to achieve this milestone.[\[71\]](#cite_note-71)

In France, the music video was broadcast on some channels with a warning *Not advised to kids under 10 years old* (in French : déconseillé aux moins de 10 ans) with some scenes from the movie blurred.[\[72\]](#cite_note-72)
